details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: heap buffer overflow in BitmapScaleBitmaps() when the
     scaled bitmap size wraps a 32-bit counter (ELSCVE-232698)
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-56001.patch: use size_t for bytestoalloc,
       reject overflow and scaled bitmaps above 256 MiB in
       src/bitmap/bitscale.c.
     - CVE-2026-56001
   * SECURITY UPDATE: heap buffer overflow and out-of-bounds read in
     pcfReadFont() with crafted PCF bitmap sizes, glyph offsets or encoding
     offsets (ELSCVE-232702)
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-56002.patch: size the repadded bitmap buffer
       from the glyph metrics and validate glyph offsets, glyph extents and
       encoding offsets in src/bitmap/pcfread.c.
     - CVE-2026-56002
   * SECURITY UPDATE: heap buffer overflow in computeProps() when scaling a
     font with many duplicate properties (ELSCVE-232689)
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-56003.patch: bound property writes by the
       remaining buffer size in src/bitmap/bitscale.c.
     - CVE-2026-56003
